notes.title: Nameless: The Departed Cycle is Now Free-to-Play... PERMANENTLY.
notes.content:
Howdy, Fiendish Friends!

In celebration of Pride Month, we have a huge announcement for you...

[b]Nameless: The Departed Cycle is now entirely free-to-play![/b]

That's right, free. Not just through June. [b]Forever.[/b]

There are a number of reasons for implementing this absolutely massive change, the largest being that unlike our flagship game Up All Night, Nameless just never found its footing as a commercial project.

Our small team thinks Nameless is an incredible story which we are all profoundly proud of, and at the end of the day we care more about people playing through, experiencing, and enjoying this queer love story than we do about scraping in the small amount of cash it brings us. We hope that by making Nameless free-to-play more folks will be interested in exploring this unique and compelling dark fantasy visual novel.

From the bottom of our hearts, we want to thank everyone who has supported Nameless and Fiendish Fiction up to this point. Your love for our little game means the world to us.

Thank you again... and as always, Stay Fiendish!

notes.title: Nameless Will Be Permanently Free-to-Play SOON!!! Happy Pride!
notes.content:
Howdy, Fiendish Friends!

In celebration of Pride Month, we have a huge announcement for you...

[b]Nameless: The Departed Cycle will soon be free-to-play on all platforms![/b]

That's right, free. There are a number of reasons for implementing this absolutely massive change, the largest being that unlike our flagship game Up All Night, Nameless just never found its footing as a commercial project.

Our small team thinks Nameless is an incredible story which we are all profoundly proud of, and at the end of the day we care more about people playing through, experiencing, and enjoying this queer love story than we do about scraping in the small amount of cash it brings us. We hope that by making Nameless free-to-play more folks will be interested in exploring this unique and compelling dark fantasy visual novel.

From the bottom of our hearts, we want to thank everyone who has supported the game up to this point. We can't thank you enough.

We will update the community shortly, when the free version is available. Currently, we are just waiting for Steam to approve and implement the change.

Thank you again... and Stay Fiendish!
